mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.title, s.category, s.cover_url, s.detail, s.guide, s.status, s.create_time, m.name AS merchantName FROM show_info s LEFT JOIN merchant m ON s.merchant_id = m.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.category, s.cover_url, s.detail, s.guide, v.name AS venueName,s.venue_id, s.status, s.audit_remark AS auditRemark, s.total_stock, s.sold_count, s.create_time FROM show_info s LEFT JOIN venue v ON s.venue_id = v.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.merchant_id = #{merchantId}

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.category, s.cover_url, s.detail, s.guide, s.status, (SELECT MIN(tc.price) FROM ticket_category tc WHERE tc.show_id = s.id) AS minPrice, (SELECT MAX(tc.price) FROM ticket_category tc WHERE tc.show_id = s.id) AS maxPrice, v.name AS venueName, v.city AS venueCity, v.address AS venueAddress FROM show_info s LEFT JOIN venue v ON s.venue_id = v.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.status NOT IN (0, 1, 2)
